description: This file contains functions for platform-specific upgrade procedures, image checks, and configuration copying for various devices within a Linux-based embedded system, likely associated with OpenWrt or a similar project.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Handles device-specific upgrade procedures based on the device's board type, including special handling for certain Buffalo models and others.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the validity and compatibility of a firmware image before upgrading, with device-specific validation.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies device-specific configuration files to appropriate locations based on the device type.
